items.q: And Vivian Fears, a very fine pianist. Remember Vivian Fears? She played with the early Gerald Wilson Orchestra a few times.

ctx.x: And Vivian Fears, a very fine pianist. Remember Vivian Fears? She played with the early Gerald Wilson Orchestra a few times. She was a very, very fine musician, a fine player.
And the Simon Brothers, Maurice and Freddie. Both of them played saxophones, and they did things... Freddie was a very fine songwriter also. And they were making marks during that period.
